补充：设计取舍、重点代码与阅读路径

设计目的：Locale Detection 与 Provider 把服务端 cookie 初值、客户端 navigator fallback、用户切换和 translations 选择串成同一套 i18n 状态流。

维度

说明

收益

SSR 和客户端都能得到稳定 locale，用户切换后通过 cookie/context 影响后续渲染。

代价

服务端和客户端检测顺序不同，调试语言问题时必须同时看 cookie、navigator、Provider state 和 Appearance 设置页。

重点代码

frontend/src/core/i18n/server.ts、frontend/src/core/i18n/locale.ts、frontend/src/core/i18n/context.tsx、frontend/src/core/i18n/hooks.ts、frontend/src/app/layout.tsx、frontend/src/components/workspace/settings/appearance-settings-page.tsx。

阅读路径

先看服务端如何从 cookie 给初值，再看客户端 effect 如何 fallback 到 navigator，最后看 changeLocale() 如何写 cookie/context。

sequenceDiagram participant Layout as RootLayout participant Server as detectLocaleServer participant Locale as normalizeLocale participant Provider as I18nProvider participant Hook as useI18n participant Cookie as cookies.ts participant Nav as navigator.language participant T as translations participant UI as AppearanceSettingsPage Layout->>Server: await detectLocaleServer Server->>Cookie: cookies get locale alt cookie present Server->>Locale: normalizeLocale cookie else no cookie Locale-->>Server: en-US default end Server-->>Layout: initialLocale Layout->>Provider: initialLocale Provider->>Provider: useState initialLocale Note over Hook: mount effect Hook->>Cookie: getLocaleFromCookie alt cookie present Cookie-->>Hook: saved value Hook->>Locale: normalizeLocale saved Hook->>Provider: setLocale normalized else no cookie Hook->>Nav: navigator.language Nav-->>Hook: browserLang Hook->>Locale: normalizeLocale browserLang Hook->>Provider: setLocale detected Hook->>Cookie: setLocaleInCookie detected end Provider-->>Hook: locale Hook->>T: translations locale Hook-->>UI: locale t changeLocale UI->>Hook: changeLocale newLocale Hook->>Provider: setLocale newLocale Hook->>Cookie: setLocaleInCookie newLocale Note over Provider: next render uses new translations

Locale 状态流转补充

阶段

源码

行为

SSR 初始值

frontend/src/app/layout.tsx、frontend/src/core/i18n/server.ts

只从 locale cookie 读取并 normalizeLocale，没有 cookie 时默认 en-US。

Client 初始化

frontend/src/core/i18n/hooks.ts

mount 后先读 document.cookie，没有 cookie 才用 navigator.language 检测，并写回 cookie。

用户切换

frontend/src/components/workspace/settings/appearance-settings-page.tsx

Select 调 changeLocale()，更新 React context 并写 cookie。
